title: Financial Crime Pattern Exploration
problem_statement: A financial-crime analytics team needs a reproducible synthetic environment to explore transaction velocity, value concentration, and labeled alert patterns without exposing customer data.
questions: Which rules could create excess alerts?
hypotheses: High velocity is associated with alert labels.
A small number of payment types drive modeled exposure.
recommendations: Optimize for investigator workload and missed-risk tradeoffs, not accuracy alone.
Review false-alert proxies by account type before threshold changes.
